name: Roth.sum_range_le_sum_of_injective
source:
theorem sum_range_le_sum_of_injective (d : Fin l → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) :
    ∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ) ≤ ∑ ν, d ν := by
  exact_mod_cast (show ((∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
      ((∑ ν, d ν : ℕ) : ℤ) by
    simpa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hd, Finset.sum_image hd.injOn,
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, Nat.cast_sum] using
      Finset.sum_range_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ.image d).map Nat.castEmbedding)
        (c := 0) (by simp))

what: The sum of l distinct natural numbers is at least the sum from zero to l−1.
how: Maps the image of the injective family into integers, uses Finset.sum_range_le_sum for its minimum possible sum, and transports the inequality back through casts.
hypotheses: An injective natural-valued function on Fin l; no coefficient-field assumptions.
